gl.renderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M2, Unspecified Version)

resident.note: viewer-side sum, ONE ENTRY PER texture.source (clones that share a source are one GPU upload) and ONE ENTRY PER BufferAttribute (chunked geometries share their vertex buffers); compressed textures from their mip data, uncompressed as w*h*4 (x4/3 with mipmaps), render targets as w*h*bpp*(1+samples) for the resolve plus the multisample buffer.  Textures are reached through material slots, through EVERY ShaderMaterial / patched uniform that holds one (Phase 8b item b: the impostor atlases live in a custom `atlas` uniform and were billed by nothing before this round), through the post chain and through scene.background / scene.environment.
